name: WeCom
label: WeCom — WeChat Work (企业微信) API
description: WeCom via the official WeChat Work (企业微信) API. Base https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin. Docs: https://developer.work.weixin.qq.com/document/path/90664. Not WeChat Official Account / personal WeChat. China-region endpoints. Operator supplies a minted access_token (query). Corp secrets are high privilege. listen = callback as BPMN message events. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One WeCom operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"send-app-message"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-app-message | send-group-robot | get-user | list-users | create-user | update-user | delete-user | list-departments | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: touser
schema.description: Userids, pipe-separated, or @all. send-app-message. Example: User1|User2.

schema.label: msgtype
schema.description: EXACT: text | markdown | image | file | textcard | news. send-app-message / send-group-robot. Example: text.

schema.label: userid
schema.description: Corp member userid: required by create-user / update-user, query value for get-user / delete-user. 1–64 characters. Example: zhangsan.

schema.label: department_id
schema.description: Department id for list-users. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: key
schema.description: Group robot webhook key (query). Treat as secret. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: toparty
schema.description: Request-body parameter `toparty` for operation: send-app-message.

schema.label: totag
schema.description: Request-body parameter `totag` for operation: send-app-message.

schema.label: agentid
schema.description: Application agentid. send-app-message. Example: 1000002.

schema.label: text
schema.description: Text payload object {content} for msgtype=text (send-app-message / send-group-robot). Escape hatch; prefer content. Example: {"content":"Hello"}.

schema.label: content
schema.description: Message text for msgtype=text on send-app-message / send-group-robot, sent as text.content (required by WeCom for text messages; max 2048 bytes). Example: Hello team.

schema.label: markdown
schema.description: Request-body parameter `markdown` for operation: send-group-robot.

schema.label: fetch_child
schema.description: Query-string parameter `fetch_child` for operation: list-users.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Member name for create-user (required) / update-user, 1–64 characters. Example: Zhang San.

schema.label: department
schema.description: Request-body parameter `department` for operations: create-user, update-user.

schema.label: mobile
schema.description: Member mobile number for create-user / update-user. create-user needs mobile or email. Example: 13800000000.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Member email for create-user / update-user. create-user needs mobile or email. Example: zhangsan@example.com.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Query-string parameter `id` for operation: list-departments.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-app-message, send-group-robot, get-user, list-users, create-user, update-user, delete-user, list-departments, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Minted WeCom access_token (from corpid+corpsecret). Query access_token. StudioQuack secret. Do not store corpsecret on INPUT. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
